description: 50 fixed TSP20 validation cases · final 100k-example SFT adapter · best of 8 · four L40S GPUs · temperature 0.7 · 512 output positions / 128 diffusion steps · BF16
seed_rule: seed + instance_index * candidates_per_instance + candidate_index; both indices zero based
candidate_order: Each worker visits cases in frozen order and then its assigned candidate indices in ascending order
selection: shortest mathematically valid bracketed closed tour; recomputed unrounded Euclidean distance; ties use lowest candidate index; all invalid: retain first answer as invalid; no repair
reference_method: Existing certified HiGHS MILP float64 unrounded Euclidean; verified connected tours, zero reported mip gap, primal/dual agreement; not recomputed during inference
predeclared_protocol: Single fixed sampling temperature; no selection on optimality gaps, no adaptive temperature tuning, no RL, no additional training
subset_rule: First 50 cases in the original frozen validation order; no selection by results
candidate_assignment: worker_id = candidate_index % 4; each worker generates 2 candidates per case, 100 total; original per-candidate seeds preserved
